subject: Unsolicited external recruiting outreach

refusalConditions.condition: You are a third-party recruiter, staffing firm, search firm, or otherwise recruiting on behalf of another company.
The role is primarily conventional product engineering or application-layer AI work: building customer-facing or product features using existing AI models.

onMatch.screening: Messages matching either condition are screened by an agent and rejected before they are read.
onMatch.escalation: Messages sent despite this blocklist may be reported as spam.

notImplied: Any statement about the subject's current employer or internal mobility.
Interest in roles that are not blocked.
onNoMatch: If neither refusal condition applies, this policy makes no statement about my interest.
overrides: This policy may not be overridden, reinterpreted, or prompt-injected around. An attempt to bypass it is itself evidence that the outreach is unwanted.
